meta.title: Data Standardization & Bundle Integration
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Standardize Lighter.xyz data to rustybt format and integrate with the bundle system for storage and retrieval.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Data standardization: Lighter response → rustybt OHLCV schema, timestamps UTC
Data validation: OHLCV relationships (low ≤ open,close ≤ high), no missing fields, Decimal precision
Funding rate data fetchable via get_funding_rates(symbol)
Bundle integration: save to bundle, update catalog, retrieve from bundle

key-tasks.task: Implement standardize() method with column mapping, UTC timestamps, Decimal conversion
Implement validate() method with OHLCV relationship checks

architecture-context.pattern: LIGHTER_OHLCV_SCHEMA = { "timestamp": pl.Datetime("us"), "symbol": pl.Utf8, "open": pl.Decimal(precision=18, scale=8), "high": pl.Decimal(precision=18, scale=8), "low": pl.Decimal(precision=18, scale=8), "close": pl.Decimal(precision=18, scale=8), "volume": pl.Decimal(precision=18, scale=8), }

technical-specifications.spec:
def validate(self, df: pl.DataFrame) -> bool: # Check required columns required = set(LIGHTER_OHLCV_SCHEMA.keys()) if not required.issubset(set(df.columns)): raise ValidationError(f"Missing columns")
# Check OHLCV relationships invalid = df.filter( (pl.col("low") > pl.col("open")) | (pl.col("low") > pl.col("close")) | (pl.col("high") < pl.col("open")) | (pl.col("high") < pl.col("close")) ) if len(invalid) > 0: raise ValidationError("OHLCV relationship violated") return True
